description: Record that the user is passing on a Himalayas job, with the reason, so it stops coming back in get_new_matches and future matches can learn from it. job_closed also reports the listing as expired. For a job already in the tracker, use update_job_status with outcome didnt_apply instead. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

company_slug.description: Company slug (from the job listing URL)

detail.description: Anything worth knowing, in a sentence or two (what the page said, a hidden requirement). No personal data.

job_slug.description: Job slug (from the job listing URL)

reason.description: Why the user is passing on it

name: skip_job
title: Skip job
